answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 6733 Country: India Title: My ammi always remains sick i.e, always pain in joints and always fever.Inspite of treatement , no relief. Could you please tell/refer any authentic dua/maslah so that if this is any satans/jins/agents of satan, work it can be destroyed and my ammi gets relief. Question: assalamualaikum. My ammi always remains sick i.e, always pain in joints and always fever.Inspite of treatement , no relief. Could you please tell/refer any authentic dua/maslah so that if this is any satans/jins/agents of satan, work it can be destroyed and my ammi gets relief. Answer ID: 6733 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1479/1296=B/1429) Your mother should recite یا سلام یا سلام very often with the intention of recovery from the disease. Moreover, while going to bed, she should recite Surah Ikhlas, Surah Falaq, Surah Naas (112, 113, 114 Surahs), blow upon her hands and pass them over whole her body. She should do this thrice. Also, she should recite الله الصمد 101 times after every obligatory salah before performing Sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
